chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the Swedish industrial consortium Industrigruppen JAS (IG JAS), including its founding members, leadership, formation date, and purpose in developing the JAS 39 Gripen aircraft.
chunks.page_content: The development, construction and manufacturing of the JAS 39 Gripen by Industrigruppen JAS (IG JAS) was on behalf of the Swedish Airforce. Saab-Scania founded Industrigruppen JAS (IG JAS). Volvo Flygmotor founded Industrigruppen JAS (IG JAS). Förenade Fabriksverken (FFV) founded Industrigruppen JAS (IG JAS). Industrigruppen JAS (IG JAS) was founded in August 1980. A contract for the development of the JAS 39 Gripen was signed on 30 June 1982. Industrigruppen JAS (IG JAS) was formed for the development, construction and manufacturing of the new Swedish combat aircraft JAS 39 Gripen. Svenska Radioaktiebolaget Communications founded Industrigruppen JAS (IG JAS). LM Ericsson founded Industrigruppen JAS (IG JAS). The tender for the JAS 39 Gripen was submitted to Försvarets Materielverk (FMV) in June 1981. Industrigruppen JAS (IG JAS) was a Swedish industrial consortium. Harald Schröder was the executive director of Industrigruppen JAS (IG JAS).

chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the Bombkapsel 90 (BK90) cluster bomb, including its nomenclature, manufacturer, technical specifications, intended and potential aircraft platforms, and design comparisons to similar weapons.
chunks.page_content: Bombkapsel 90 is manufactured by DaimlerChrysler Aerospace. Bombkapsel 90 is commonly known as DWS 39 "Mjölner". Bombkapsel 90 was intended for use with the Saab JAS 39 Gripen. Bombkapsel 90 could be integrated on the Eurofighter Typhoon in the future. DaimlerChrysler Aerospace manufactures Bombkapsel 90 under the name DWS 24. Bombkapsel 90 is also known as a cluster bomb. The design of Bombkapsel 90 is very similar to that of the American AGM-154 Joint Standoff Weapon. Bombkapsel 90 is abbreviated as BK90. Bombkapsel 90 is the Swedish Air Force's nomenclature for a gliding stand-off submunitions dispenser. Bombkapsel 90 has 72 submunitions.

chunks.chunk_summary: This chunk contains information about the designations, alternative names, technical characteristics, development history, and operational deployment of the V3E A-Darter missile system.
chunks.page_content: The V3E A-Darter will equip the Brazilian Air Force's Gripen E/F. The V3E A-Darter was developed by Brazil's Mectron. The V3E A-Darter will equip the Brazilian Air Force's A-1M AMX. The V3E A-Darter is a modern short-range infrared homing air-to-air missile. The V3E A-Darter features a 120-degrees per second track rate. The V3E A-Darter is expected to be in production before the end of 2015. The V3E A-Darter was developed by Brazil's Opto Eletrônica. The V3E A-Darter is a heat seeking air-to-air missile. The V3E A-Darter is also known as the Agile Darter. The V3E A-Darter will equip the South African Air Force's Saab JAS 39 Gripen C/D. The V3E A-Darter features a 180-degree look angle. The V3E A-Darter features countermeasures resistance. The V3E A-Darter was developed by South Africa's Denel Dynamics. The V3E A-Darter will equip the South African Air Force's BAe Hawk 120. The V3E A-Darter will equip the Brazilian Air Force's Northrop F-5BR. The V3E A-Darter was developed by Brazil's Avibras.
